contracts_revalidated: All3 changed files freshly read completely from Gitb874, including all2103 renderer lines; complete frame_state and deformation modules. Actual affected readback, explicit scene invalidation, convergence and scalar sample formulas source-traced. Full post/deform shader source freshly read and every shader exactparent; no source execution used.

FrameProgress is local candidate state: prepare_frame immutably copies published count/history/moving and selected finite view. Same invalidation predicate as6b resets only candidate samples/history when view differs or accumulation lacks current history. prepare_frame never mutates last, frames, history or movement. Render keeps candidate through native recording and stores its new ping-pong slot locally. No retained competing authority or extra generation introduced.

Earlyreturn is_complete requires frames>=wanted and !moving. Wanted is target()>=1; any changed view or missing accumulation history resets candidateframes0, so cannot incorrectly earlyreturn while discarding a meaningful new identity. An actual completed sameview leaves prior published state unchanged and returns same frames/primitives. Initial/reset/scene-replaced state cannot claim a frame without submission.

Successful numeric behavior matches6b: candidate pre-frame count drives same n=count%64+1 Halton values, same shader uniforms and draw plans, same previous().next() temporal target, same u64-based next_weight and moving max0.35. Resolved-only static source still bypasses accumulation; resolved-only→multi target resets to0/Empty and usesweight1. Alreadycurrent mean extends normally. publish_frame increments saturating samplecount once after normal submission, publishes exact candidate history/view, clearsmovement, and FrameInfo reads that same newcount.

RecordedDeformations stores at most3 actual strand ordinals in fixed original main/shadow/blend slots. It skips absent/non-strand views, checks pending, and deduplicates contains(Some(level)) BEFORE recording, preserving original first-occurrence order and one deformation per selected level even though retained state is no longer mutated to deduplicate. A missing pending/dynamic level does not enter record. Hidden pending levels remain untouched. After normal submit, publisher marks only recorded indices Current via checkedget_mut.

Commands finish and queue.submit both occur before publish_deformations and publish_frame. Any synchronous error return or unwind before normal return drops candidates/recorded ordinals without consuming published temporal identity, samplecount, history, movement or pending obligations. Post-submit publishers are allocation-free simple checked state assignments/count saturation. Exclusive &mut render prevents safe concurrent mutation of its source state between prepare/record/publish. No assumption about user-held native buffer aliases is added.

The transaction concerns receiving metadata, not rollback of native queuewrites/resource allocations or proof commands were accepted/completed. Shadow map resources may be replaced and uniform queue writes issued before submit; these are outside the stated deferred temporal/deformation metadata. Agreed device-handled native policy remains: a custom native handler returning normally after rejection can still let submit return, and asynchronous/later failure is not observed here. No GPUcompletionWait or new context helper is introduced.

Readback still requires published lastSome and frames>0; a first attempt that fails before normal submit cannot advertise pixels. Previously published frame identity survives a failed candidate; resize/scene replacement still explicitly invalidates. converged still compares published effective policy and !moving; failed movement attempt therefore remains nonconverged. Missing targets/nonfinite admission remains typed and occurs before candidate publication.

Shader semantics are unchanged: post mix(before,now,weight), tonemap/exposure/sRGB, deform absolute rest/head/weightedguide and native addressing remain exactparent. Candidate publication does not claim arbitrary finite shader-output validity or repair raw native layout/count/source admissions. Constructor docs now accurately distinguish returned host atlas allocation/admission errors from configured native pipeline/resource/queue error handling (Atlas6B-C1).
